why: The whole value of this law is the shape "every arm unreachable, therefore not measured, therefore not a pass". This mutation deletes the guard that carries that shape: the branch that turns an empty measured set into NOT_MEASURED is deactivated, so a window where three platform arms each refused the connection falls through to the success branch and prints PASS with n_measured=0 and p50_ms=null. That is the failure a green probe hides: an outage reported as healthy, with no percentiles to contradict it.
measured: scripts/observability/probe_core.py: summarise() guards non-empty-but-unreachable windows before it grades anything; the offline arm takes the guard, so the green printout says not_measured.

mutations.comment: deactivate the all-unreachable guard so an empty window reaches the PASS branch
